name: Darkcasting spawns a Blood Orb on an ability critical strike (#3042)
contract: Darkcasting 706247: "Critical strikes with abilities now spawn a Blood Orb near you for $707434d." 706247 is aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 707434 with ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so it never procs. 707434 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 315303 (SummonProperties 61, 15 s), and coa_world has no creature_template 315303. Picking the orb up should apply Darkcasting 712383, which spell_ascension_animated_blood already consumes. The probe is Bloodmoon Blast 500125 with maximum spell crit rating. The orb pulses 712418 every 200 ms, whose 712419 (2 yd) is the pickup. DISCRIMINATING: after the talent, a critical Bloodmoon Blast spawns a Blood Orb that casts 712418. The orb spawns anywhere within 707434's 6 yd, so it may be collected at once; the orb's own cast is asserted instead of its presence. The pickup half (712383, 712385) is not asserted because the runner cannot walk to a random point.
